title: Glenn Gaffney said to have run the crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: be the frontier of defense. There's also a guy who was rumored to to run the whole legacy crash retrieval program named Glenn Gaffne, and he was the CIA's director of science and technology.

plain: Glenn Gaffney, once the CIA's director of science and technology, was rumoured to run the whole "legacy crash retrieval program", a supposed secret effort to recover and study crashed craft that are not man-made. Michels passes this on himself as a rumour, without naming who told it. If true, it would mean a senior CIA official ran the effort.
